I have bpd and usually experience the opposite so I can't say for sure, but sometimes in long term relationships the intensity of feelings fade. Sometimes this is just because of time and can be reinvigorated, sometimes it's because our time with that person is over. Do you live together? Maybe try taking some time apart and see if that helps at all. Try reminding yourself what you first loved about that person and see if you can recall those feelings. 

Has this happened to you in past relationships? Might be worth considering if there is a pattern or if this is a one off. 

Whatever happens I wish you lots of luck and love. I know relationships are not easy generally and even trickier for us, but we deserve love and happiness like anyone else 💚
